candidates.prompt: Create ONE independently designed square 1024x1024 SEAMLESS repeatable CHINESE HANBAIYU white marble palace plaza GROUND MATERIAL base-color / DIFFUSE ALBEDO texture. It is a completely flat orthographic top-down material image, filled edge to edge by stone: no camera tilt or perspective, no scene, no sculpture, no material ball, no objects, no horizon or tiled sample montage. Match a bright clean miniature Chinese imperial palace with vermilion pillars and gold roofs, whose warm AFTERNOON SUN will be applied by the engine later. The unlit stone base itself remains light, warm-neutral ivory white around #f2ede2, airy and calm, not dark gray, blue-white or black marble. This texture must repeat naturally in BOTH horizontal and vertical directions, with consistent fine mineral grain and tone at opposite edges; no outer border, no edge strips, no central subject, no global brightness slope or visible colored box. Smooth finely compact crystalline white stone, subtle fine material detail rather than sandy rough concrete, with only restrained small color variations. Uniform neutral diffuse presentation: NO baked directional sun, highlights, reflective gloss streaks, mirrored windows, shadows, relief, bevel shading, ambient-occlusion crevices, specular shine, wet reflection, glow or vignette. No engraved lines, cracks, black veins, strong dark streaks, metallic gold foil, ornate emblems, rings, glyphs, checker pattern, decorative tile border or repeating central medallions. No soot, oil, dirt patches, rubble, plants, leaves, blood, fresh red color, lettering, people, faces, animals or architecture. No slab-outline grid: this is a continuous stone-material repeat; geometry/stone joints can be handled separately in the game. Output a single high-resolution texture without transparency. VARIANT 1: pale milky-white Hanbaiyu with a very fine compact crystalline micrograin, tiny softly mottled off-white mineral freckles and scattered barely-visible pin-sized warm gray-beige inclusions. Mostly homogeneous light base #f2ede2 / #f5f0e7 / #eee8dc with softly interspersed fine grains, no long veins, no cloudy large blobs, no gritty holes. The material should read as smooth quiet natural white carved stone, not flat blank paper; minute mineral variation spread evenly across the square and no distinctive repeating focal feature.
